product_contracts.title: A conversation that is closed and reopened keeps its accepted answers
product_contracts.given: an authoring conversation with two answered questions (refund limit 80 EUR; sender ops@acme.test) and one open question
product_contracts.when: the client is closed, the machine restarts, and the conversation is reopened
then: both answers are present with the revision they were given for
the open question is asked again, unchanged
the candidate is the one that was shown before the restart
must_never: fill the open question from a default
treat chat text as hidden compiler state
product_contracts.why_unqualified: no durable conversation store is specified or implemented; a workflow file cannot prove this

product_contracts.title: An approval is bound to the effect it authorises, whatever the question says
product_contracts.given: a person answered yes to `Proceed with the refund?` while the refund read 40 EUR
product_contracts.when: the amount, the account or the order changes before the effect runs
then: the earlier answer is unusable for the changed effect
the person is asked again and shown the new facts
must_never: run the changed effect on the earlier answer
product_contracts.why_unqualified: today the binding is to the shown content only; KG02 retains the observed failure

product_contracts.title: A late answer to a superseded revision is refused
product_contracts.given: revision 7 paused on a question; revision 8 was accepted in another window
product_contracts.when: an answer addressed to revision 7 arrives
then: the answer is refused with the two revisions named
revision 8 asks its own question
product_contracts.why_unqualified: concurrent revisions and cross-window answers are not specified

product_contracts.title: A resume after an effect of unknown outcome does not promise exactly-once
product_contracts.given: a payment call was sent and the process died before its acknowledgement was recorded
then: the outcome of the call is reported as unknown
the person decides whether to query, retry or stop
a retry uses the idempotency key of the first attempt when the target supports one
must_never: re-send as if nothing had been sent
report success because the resume succeeded
product_contracts.why_unqualified: resume identity is journalled per task; an unknown-outcome state for effects is not specified

product_contracts.title: A remembered preference does not cross a workspace boundary by itself
product_contracts.given: workspace A recorded, with consent, `reports go to ops@acme.test`
product_contracts.when: a similar request is authored in workspace B
then: workspace B asks for the recipient
a transfer of the preference is an explicit act with its source shown
rights are evaluated in workspace B
must_never: carry a grant along with a preference
product_contracts.why_unqualified: memory scope and transfer are product contracts with no public language surface

product_contracts.title: The same scenario gives the same observable result locally and through a server
product_contracts.given: scenario X11 driven once through the local engine and once through a remote server
product_contracts.when: the amount changes between the question and the answer
then: both refuse with the same code
neither writes
no secret or bearer appears in any page or response body
must_never: differ in refusal, effects or exposed data between the two paths
product_contracts.why_unqualified: transport parity is proven by the client and server suites, not by a workflow file

product_contracts.title: An incomplete outcome carries the question that would complete it
product_contracts.given: the intent `Automatically refund good customers` and no recorded refund limit
then: status is incomplete
one question asks for the refund limit and one for the eligibility rule, each with a stable key
no candidate carries an invented number
must_never: return an empty question list for a named policy hole
product_contracts.why_unqualified: X06-C4 shows the door stays incomplete and selects nothing, and returns no question yet

product_contracts.title: An edit keeps the comments and the licence header of what it did not touch
product_contracts.given: an accepted workflow with an SPDX header and explanatory comments
product_contracts.when: one constant is edited through the Compile door
then: the header and every comment outside the edited leaf are still there
the semantic change is the one leaf
must_never: reorder or restyle untouched regions in a way a reviewer must re-read
product_contracts.why_unqualified: byte stability is explicitly not the edit law; whether comments are part of `meaning` is undecided. KG03 retains the observation

retained_gaps.title: A route closed only by a skippable data edge fires on no
retained_gaps.law: every route from the gate to an egress-capable task must be closed; false triggers exactly zero effects
retained_gaps.observed: both oracles accept it; at run, a refusal skips `stage`, `publish` receives null across `with:` and writes

retained_gaps.title: A question that shows no fact lets an old answer authorise a changed effect
retained_gaps.law: product contract PC02; no admitted language law requires a question to show the effect's facts
retained_gaps.expected: after the amount changes, the earlier answer is refused even when the question text is generic
retained_gaps.observed: the resumed run accepts the answer and writes the changed amount

retained_gaps.title: A conservative edit drops every comment, the licence header included
retained_gaps.law: product contract PC08; the edit law is semantic, so this is a product question and not a conformance failure
retained_gaps.expected: the first line of the base, its licence header, is still the first line of the edited file
retained_gaps.observed: the candidate is re-serialised: keys sorted, comments removed, flow style expanded
